{{Quote|Did they ''react'' when the Trandoshans invaded?|Alto Stratus, to Jabiimi Nationalists|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
The '''Trandoshan invasion''' was an invasion by<ref name="FF125" /> [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bandits<ref name="db" /> that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]<ref name="FF125" /> at some point between [[3000 BBY]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Republic 55" /> in an attempt to steal stockpiles of the [[Jabiimi]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]].<ref name="GaW" /> During the invasion, Trandoshans occupied Jabiim's lands before moving on.<ref name="db" /> In response to the incursions by the raiders, the [[Jabiimi]] [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]] formed a ground [[Army/Legends|army]] and a small stellar [[Navy/Legends|navy]].<ref name="GaW" />
